calibrated_E_threshold: dev macro-F1 only; also report separately
gate: abs(p_unsafe - 0.5) <= dev uncertainty quantile; mandatory overflow always routed
cascade_subset: selection.json test ids, fixed before native model predictions
cache_metrics: logical cascade only; sum of component latencies is an estimate
live_router: seed42 dev25percent gate, first two routed and first two non-routed test IDs in frozen order; no label selection; same E score for both arms
abstain_transitions: reported separately in 3x3 correctness matrix; never count abstain as correct
